Adobe, stone masonry and earthen construction. DEVIATES FROM RASMI, which counts adobe and stone as masonry (S.4): these buildings contain little or no concrete (estimate 0 to 0.1 m3/m2 against about 0.5 for masonry with concrete slabs), so they get no material intensity (U)
Other: unspecified, informal, mobile, metal. Matches RASMI S.5 unspecified structure
